preconditions.description: The input must be a string representing the kookaburra calls.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len([call for call in input_str.split(' ') if call == 'HaHaHa' or call == 'hahaha'])
postconditions.description: The output is the total count of kookaburra calls (both male and female) in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(call in ['HaHaHa', 'hahaha'] for call in input_str.split(' ') if call != '')
postconditions.description: Every non-empty call in the input string must be either 'HaHaHa' (male) or 'hahaha' (female).
